Record the research intent, evidence contract, defaults audit and pre-mortem before measurements. Keep existing component APIs unchanged unless a separately documented defect requires repair. Implement preparation and evaluation as separate invocations: preparation writes the protocol, references and hashes into benchmark.json; evaluation verifies those hashes and appends observed results.
